pages.title: Bend the Dawn: Light Bending Puzzle
pages.creator: Intelligentia Studios

pages.title: Cooking Block Fever
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Cooking Block Fever combines a kitchen theme with a block-placement puzzle. Drag shapes onto the board to complete lines and clear space, planning around the pieces that remain as the levels become more demanding.

pages.title: Klumen
pages.creator: José Soares
pages.description: Klumen asks you to restore a broken weave of light. Rotate tiles to join their filaments and carry light from the central star across the board. Later puzzles introduce obstacles, portals, one-way paths and color-mixing prisms.

pages.title: Football Heads 2026
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Football Heads 2026 pits two large-headed footballers against each other in timed matches. Move, jump and kick to outscore your opponent while dealing with random power-ups. Victories help you climb divisions and unlock further rewards.

pages.title: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets casts you as a detective searching detailed scenes for clues. Pan across the location and zoom in to find the listed objects, calling on your assistant's hints when a small detail proves difficult to locate.

pages.title: Lost Things - Hidden Objects
pages.creator: Illusions Games
pages.description: Lost Things - Hidden Objects lets you explore large maps without a timer. Find the concealed items to open additional sections of the picture, using a hint to move the camera toward an overlooked object when needed.

pages.title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle lets you choose a Brainrot form and fight other characters in an arena. Attack opponents and unlock new weapons and abilities as you progress, including a protective shield and a slow-motion power.

pages.title: That's my seat!
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: That's my seat! asks you to place a group of characters according to written clues. Compare the hints about their relationships and seating positions, then assign each person a seat that satisfies the level's complete set of rules.

pages.title: Fishing Bear
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Fishing Bear puts a fishing line in your hands and asks you to reel in a catch. Tap to bring fish toward you while watching for sea creatures that interfere. Treasure shells add surprises to the fishing session.

pages.title: Stickman Zombie vs Stickman Hero
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Stickman Zombie vs Stickman Hero lets you play both sides of a pursuit. As the human hero, shoot zombies and reach the level's end; as a zombie, infect the stickmen along the route before reaching the finish.

pages.title: Water Sort
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Water Sort challenges you to organize mixed colors into matching bottles. Select a bottle and pour into another when the receiving color and remaining capacity allow it. Plan transfers carefully so the colors can be separated without blocking further moves.

pages.title: Kids Supermarket
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Kids Supermarket turns a shopping trip into an item-finding activity. Browse the store's products and locate the goods you need, comparing the items on the shelves as you work through the supermarket simulation.

pages.title: Garden Block Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Garden Block Puzzle links line-clearing challenges with restoring a neglected garden. Place brick shapes to complete lines and advance through levels, unlocking tools that help remove the garden's weeds and bring its surroundings back into shape.

pages.title: Hospital Game Happy Clinic
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Hospital Game Happy Clinic puts you in charge of a virtual clinic receiving patients. Carry out the game's treatment activities and collect coins for completed care. Use the earnings to update the hospital and expand its services.

pages.title: NG: Flow Lines
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: NG: Flow Lines asks you to connect each pair of same-colored dots with a continuous path. Drag across the grid to lay the routes, making sure different lines do not overlap as you complete the required connections.

pages.title: Hotfoot Baseball
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Hotfoot Baseball keeps the action going after the ball leaves the bat. Tap to swing, then decide when your runner should leave a base for the next one. Time both hitting and running to turn a play into runs.

pages.title: Nitro Speed Car Racing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Nitro Speed Car Racing makes acceleration depend on a timing dial. Stop the pointer at the right moment to earn a nitro burst and push toward the finish. Collect coins to improve the car's engine and nitro performance.

pages.title: BitGoblins RPG Simulator
pages.creator: Gametok
pages.description: BitGoblins RPG Simulator follows a hero defending a kingdom against goblins and ogres. Earn gold and items from battles, then use upgrade buttons to strengthen the character. Take on bosses and different modes to gather further gold and crystals.

pages.title: Blue Girls Makeup
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Blue Girls Makeup gives you a character to style with a range of cosmetics. Experiment with eyeshadow, lipstick and other makeup choices, combining colors into your own finished look through the game's makeover activities.

pages.title: Garden Tales 4
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Garden Tales 4 continues Willy the gnome's garden matching adventure. Swap fruits, flowers and plants to form groups of at least three, collecting the items required by each stage. Follow the map through increasingly challenging boards.

pages.title: Find the Difference: Wednesday Mode
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay
pages.description: Find the Difference: Wednesday Mode presents paired pictures with small details changed between them. Search both images and select the differences you notice, comparing their objects and markings as you work through puzzles of varying difficulty.

pages.title: Rock Paper Scissors
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Rock Paper Scissors lets you face a solo opponent or another player in short matches. Choose a hand sign and compare it with your rival's choice. The first player to win three rounds takes the match.

pages.title: Crypto Head Ball
pages.creator: TastyCherryGames
pages.description: Crypto Head Ball gives an arcade ball match a cryptocurrency theme and ape players. Move, jump and kick to send the ball past the opponent and build your score. Customize the characters and ball's appearance between matches.

pages.title: System Puzzle
pages.creator: Straydog Studio
pages.description: System Puzzle turns repairing a virus-damaged system into a shape-fitting challenge. Drag suitable blocks from the bottom panel into the gap, arranging them to close the hole completely before moving on to the next repair.

pages.title: Metazoa Jigsaw
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Metazoa Jigsaw asks you to reconstruct pictures from scattered puzzle pieces before time runs out. Choose between two modes, each containing twenty-four levels, and fit the pieces together to restore the original image within the allowance.

pages.title: Daily Solitaire Blue
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Daily Solitaire Blue provides a new Klondike deal each day with changing difficulty. Organize the cards into four foundations, building upward from aces to kings. Completing the daily challenges contributes toward the game's monthly rewards.

pages.title: Idle Survival
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Idle Survival strands a man on a desert island with the task of staying alive. Search for food, gather useful materials and craft the things he needs. Build a house while developing the supplies necessary for life on the island.

pages.title: Word Duel
pages.creator: Fish Pond Studio
pages.description: Word Duel puts two players into a fast word competition across five thirty-second rounds. Follow the letter challenges and try to outperform your opponent before each round ends. Different arenas offer increasing competition and gold rewards.

pages.title: Cake Blocks Collapse
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Cake Blocks Collapse lets you remove connected groups of same-colored blocks by tapping them. Look for horizontal and vertical connections, since larger collapses score more points. The bottom display previews the value of your selected group.

pages.title: Zonic Rush Toilet
pages.creator: KukoGames
pages.description: Zonic Rush Toilet follows a hedgehog racing to reach the bathroom in time. Move and jump through the route, breaking boxes and other objects that obstruct the way. Keep clearing a path before the urgent trip ends badly.

pages.title: Dream Restaurant
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Dream Restaurant starts you serving burgers and sandwiches to waiting customers. Carry orders to tables and collect the money they leave, using the income to grow the restaurant. Keep moving between the kitchen and the diners to handle demand.

pages.title: Mad Defense
pages.creator: UznGames
pages.description: Mad Defense puts an engineer and his inventions in charge of protecting a castle. Fire at the attacking creatures and earn gold for improvements to the weapons and fortress. Recruit the engineer's brothers to help sustain the defense.

pages.title: Clone Ball Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Clone Ball Rush sends a group of balls along obstacle-filled tracks. Steer toward green gates to enlarge or multiply the group and avoid red gates that reduce it. Get at least one ball past the finish flag to complete the level.

pages.title: King Soldiers Ultimate Edition
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: King Soldiers Ultimate Edition gives you monster targets to eliminate with well-aimed shots. Clear all the frogs in each stage while using as few shots as possible, working toward a three-star result for the level.

pages.title: Memoji Puzzle
pages.creator: Fun Velikan
pages.description: Memoji Puzzle asks you to match character portraits with phrases about their identities. Compare each face with clues about professions, emotions, traits or achievements, then select the pairings that fit the descriptions to complete the level.

pages.title: Boxing Stars
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Boxing Stars follows a boxer climbing from early fights toward championship tournaments. Combine attacks, blocks and movement to knock out opponents, then spend earned rewards on improved abilities. Stronger skills prepare your fighter for the next competition.

pages.title: Bubble Game 3 Deluxe
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bubble Game 3 Deluxe challenges you to clear a board of colored bubbles with aimed shots. Keep finding useful placements to remove more bubbles, collecting coins that can buy different backgrounds and bubble designs from the shop.

pages.title: Rolling Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Rolling Ball sends a ball through a narrow tunnel interrupted by barriers. Tap at the right moment to take an obstacle out of its path, watching the ball's approach so it can continue rolling without crashing.

pages.title: Ice Cream Sundae Maker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Ice Cream Sundae Maker asks you to build the sundae requested by each customer. Drop the ice cream in the correct sequence to reproduce the order, aiming for three stars across the game's fifty levels.

pages.title: Dream Chefs
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Dream Chefs puts you in a restaurant kitchen preparing customer orders. Choose and make the requested dishes, keeping track of what each diner wants as you work. Completing the meals is the focus of the cooking challenge.

pages.title: MR.COP MASTER
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: MR.COP MASTER turns a secret agent's shooting missions into aiming challenges. Drag to set the shot and release to fire at the enemies in the scene. Plan your line of fire to eliminate the targets and finish the mission.

pages.title: Supra Drift & Stunt
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Supra Drift & Stunt gives you a Supra to drive through a Tokyo-inspired city at night. Explore the streets, perform drifts and try to increase your score. Boost and slow motion provide additional options during the driving session.

pages.title: Candy Puzzle Blocks Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Candy Puzzle Blocks Halloween asks you to fit candy-shaped block groups onto a board. Drag each group into a useful space and complete full lines to remove them, keeping enough room available for the next pieces.

pages.title: My Puzzle
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: My Puzzle asks you to put picture pieces into their matching positions. Drag each section into place to rebuild scenes featuring objects, animals and other subjects, checking the shape and image details as you complete each puzzle.

pages.title: Crazy Big American Cars Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Crazy Big American Cars Memory hides vehicle pictures behind tiles for a matching challenge. Flip two tiles at a time and remember where their pictures appear. Find every pair through four levels while trying to keep your move count low.

pages.title: Superstar Hair Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Superstar Hair Salon lets you choose a girl and design a new hairstyle for her. Work through the salon styling choices to shape a finished look, experimenting with the available options to suit your chosen client.

pages.title: Classic Muscle Cars Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Classic Muscle Cars Jigsaw Puzzle includes eight vehicle pictures to assemble. Choose a 2-by-3, 3-by-4 or 4-by-6 piece layout, then drag each section into its exact position to reconstruct the complete muscle-car image.

pages.title: Lion Hunter King
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Lion Hunter King puts you in a virtual hunting area with lions as the targets. Move into position, use the weapon's zoom and line up your aim before firing. Work through the targets in the sniper-style hunting challenge.

pages.title: Iceland Limo Taxi
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Iceland Limo Taxi asks you to carry tourists to scenic mountain destinations in a limousine. Drive along steep roads and sharp turns, controlling your speed to reach the drop-off safely. Pick up the next passengers as you continue the route.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire 2
pages.creator: Zigiz
pages.description: Spider Solitaire 2 challenges you to clear columns of cards by building same-suit sequences from king to ace. Move individual cards or consecutive suited groups into useful positions, planning ahead to keep further moves available.

pages.title: BTS Princess Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Princess Coloring Book provides princess drawings that you can decorate with your chosen colors. Select a picture and fill its outlines to create a finished scene. The images can also be printed for coloring away from the screen.

pages.title: Sweet Sixty
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Sweet Sixty imagines princesses celebrating their sixtieth birthdays. Help them choose festive outfits for the occasion, putting together coordinated looks for the party. The styling activity pairs a later chapter of their lives with a sweet-themed celebration.

pages.title: Zombie Reunion
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Zombie Reunion puts you in a tank facing approaching zombies. Move the vehicle and fire its gun to stop the undead as they arrive, keeping your shots directed toward the next threat in the tank's path.

pages.title: Truck Driver Cargo
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Truck Driver Cargo asks you to carry a heavy load along dangerous mountain roads. Steer through the sharp bends and manage your speed with the brakes, keeping the truck under control so its cargo reaches the destination safely.

pages.title: Family Bike Ride In Park Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Family Bike Ride In Park Match 3 turns its outing theme into a tile-matching board. Arrange three or more identical tiles in a row to earn points, watching the side gauge so it does not drop low enough to end the round.

pages.title: Inca Adventure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Inca Adventure follows an archaeologist and her father into a pyramid in search of treasure. Coordinate the two characters across twenty levels, using their movement, weapons and wall-jumping abilities to overcome the dangers together.

pages.title: Indian Truck Driver Cargo Duty Delivery
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Indian Truck Driver Cargo Duty Delivery puts a loaded truck on rough hill routes. Guide the transporter through changing road conditions and dangerous turns, controlling its speed to keep the cargo secure until you reach the delivery point.

pages.title: Flying Car Simulator 3d
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Flying Car Simulator 3d gives you a vehicle that can travel both on city roads and through the air. Explore the modern city, collect points and try jumps from buildings as you earn cash with your chosen car.

pages.title: Christmas Bubble Shooter 2019
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas Bubble Shooter 2019 asks you to rescue trapped bubbles by clearing the board around them. Fire into matching groups of at least three and use the effects of special bubbles, including mines and thunder bubbles, to help complete levels.

pages.title: Moto Quest: Bike racing
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Moto Quest: Bike racing brings motorcycle drag racing into a retro-styled competition. Race rival bikers, then repair and upgrade your motorcycle between contests. Unlock and purchase additional bikes as you work through the opposing biker clans.

pages.title: Sailor Warriors New Era
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Sailor Warriors New Era lets you design a new magical heroine to face an outer-space threat. Combine a top, skirt, shoes and other costume choices into a unique warrior outfit, shaping the character's appearance before her adventure.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Birthday Party
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Birthday Party follows Hazel's third-birthday celebration. Help fulfill her requests while she enjoys dancing, food and a magic show with the guests. Keep her happy through the activities and discover the surprise planned for the party.

pages.title: Stickman Upgrade Complete
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Upgrade Complete makes improving the game itself part of your progress. Fight enemies to gather gold, then spend it on better graphics and stronger combat abilities. Keep developing both the stickman's skills and the presentation around him.

pages.title: Pixel Gun Apocalypse
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Pixel Gun Apocalypse takes first-person shooting into a block-built environment. Move through the area, aim and fire with a selection of weapons, reloading as needed. Crouching, going prone and sprinting give you different ways to reposition during combat.

pages.title: Jeep Parking 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Jeep Parking 3D challenges you to maneuver a jeep into its parking position. Steer through the course and use the handbrake when needed, making careful corrections so the vehicle lines up within the available space.

pages.title: Surviving in the Woods
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Surviving in the Woods starts you in a forest with an axe. Cut trees, gather materials and use them to build a shelter, managing the items you pick up. Choose between daytime and nighttime forest locations for the survival setting.

pages.title: Robotex
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Robotex is an assembly puzzle built around different robots. Select and fit the available components together to construct each machine, working out where the separate parts belong as the complete robot takes shape.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Winter Fun
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Winter Fun follows Hazel and her friends through a snowy day. Help her draw a snowman, build a colorful igloo and try skiing, responding to the activities as she makes plans for her winter outing.

pages.title: BTS Motorbike Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Motorbike Coloring offers motorcycle outlines for a custom paint design. Choose colors and apply them across the bike's parts, experimenting with the palette until the picture has the appearance you want.

pages.title: Dexomon
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Dexomon sends you around a map to battle and collect monsters. Build up your group through encounters and train the creatures you gather. Preparing a stronger collection helps you face the rounds leading toward the final boss.

pages.title: EG Zombie Buster
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Zombie Buster puts a bazooka in your hands against a group of zombies. Aim and launch explosive shots to clear the undead from the scene, choosing a useful firing direction before releasing each bomb.

pages.title: EG Uno Io
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Uno Io brings numbered and special-action cards into a turn-based matching game. Play a suitable card from your hand, draw when needed and use action cards to change the next turns. Work toward getting rid of your remaining cards.

pages.title: Color by Block
pages.creator: PulseNova
pages.description: Color by Block sends a rolling ball across puzzles that need to be painted. Swipe to move it through the layout and spread color along its route, working out a path that reaches the remaining unpainted areas.

pages.title: Match 3030!
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Match 3030! combines colored-brick matching with changeable block shapes. Click a block to choose its form and arrange at least three of the same color in a row. Matching sets disappear, opening space for further combinations.

pages.title: Monster Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Monster Truck Jigsaw contains twelve monster-truck pictures with three difficulty choices. Select a 25-, 49- or 100-piece puzzle and rebuild the image, connecting the vehicle's wheels, bodywork and background until the scene is complete.

pages.title: EG Pino
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Pino asks you to feed a penguin with falling fish while dodging bombs. Move left and right to catch each fish before it reaches the ground. Missing three fish ends the attempt, and the falling items gradually arrive faster.

pages.title: EG Hold Position
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Hold Position challenges you to keep enemies under fire from a defensive turret. Move the cursor to aim and click to shoot, collecting coins during the fighting. Spend those coins on turret upgrades to strengthen the position.

pages.title: 2D Shooters
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: 2D Shooters pits you against computer-controlled fighters in a two-dimensional shooting game. Use the available weapons, grenades and melee attacks to engage the bots, trying to build your score through the combat encounters.

pages.title: Rush Hour 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Rush Hour 3D sends you along a highway filled with cars, trucks and other hazards. Adjust your driving and braking to avoid crashes while the road continues ahead. Staying on the highway longer gives you a chance at a higher score.

pages.title: Casual Crossword
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Casual Crossword presents everyday crossword grids on themes such as food, cities, objects and buildings. Read the clues, select the corresponding spaces and enter your answers, using intersecting letters to help complete the rest of the puzzle.

pages.title: Highschool Love Story
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Highschool Love Story lets you help Elsa prepare for a school day with Jack. Choose her makeup and put together a school outfit, coordinating the styling choices so she is ready to meet him.

pages.title: Crazy Ball Adventures
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Crazy Ball Adventures challenges you to guide a ball through obstacle-filled levels. Roll and jump toward the finish, collecting stars and reaching checkpoints along the route. Watch the ball's position carefully to avoid falling or striking a hazard.

pages.title: Super Cowboy Run
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Super Cowboy Run sends a cowboy along a coin-collecting run. Keep him moving through the route and gather as many coins as possible before the timer expires, aiming to improve the total earned during each attempt.

pages.title: War Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: War Simulator lets you arrange different kinds of units and watch them fight. Choose the forces for the simulated battle, then move, rotate or zoom the camera to follow how the confrontation develops across the battlefield.

pages.title: Arcade Darts
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Arcade Darts challenges you to set the direction of a dart and land it near the center of the target. Aim for bonus symbols to increase the score while avoiding the bombs that interrupt a successful throw.

pages.title: Descendants Hair Salon
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Descendants Hair Salon brings Evie, Mal and Loonie into the salon before filming. Choose a client and work through the hairstyling options, shaping a new look for each character as she prepares for the next episode.

pages.title: Two Dots
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Two Dots asks you to connect same-colored dots horizontally or vertically for points. Forming squares increases the reward. Choose among modes that include timed play and a limited-move challenge, adapting your connections to the selected rules.

pages.title: EDC Vegas Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: EDC Vegas Hairstyles features three festival-inspired hairstyles to create. Follow the salon activity for your chosen look and work through its styling steps, preparing the character's hair for an appearance at the music festival.

pages.title: Money Detector: Dollars Differences
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Money Detector: Dollars Differences asks you to find seven changes between paired dollar-banknote pictures. Compare the details on one-, two-, five-, ten- and twenty-dollar designs, completing five levels and working toward fifteen stars.

pages.title: Dress Up The Lovely Princess
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Dress Up The Lovely Princess gives you a royal wardrobe for creating a new look. Choose clothes and combine the available fashion pieces around the princess, experimenting with different selections until the finished outfit suits your style.

pages.title: Going Nuts Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Going Nuts Game asks you to feed a hungry squirrel by dropping it through a field of nuts and acorns. Choose the release point so it collects food along the way and lands in a rewarding basket below.

pages.title: Find The Candy 1
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Find The Candy 1 hides a sweet and three stars inside each room. Move objects, open chests, remove presents and cut ropes to uncover them. Search for the stars before selecting the candy to finish the scene.

pages.title: Fancy Diver
pages.creator: IP Konstantin Boronenkov
pages.description: Fancy Diver asks you to clear colored blocks so a diver can reach the surface. Remove groups of at least three matching blocks, creating bonuses from larger groups. Open the route before the diver runs out of air.

pages.title: Princesses BFFs Fall Party
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princesses BFFs Fall Party lets you dress Anna and Elsa for an autumn picnic in Arendelle. Choose casual outfits for the sisters as they prepare to welcome Belle and Ariel, coordinating looks suited to their forest celebration.

pages.title: Zombie Crisis
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Zombie Crisis challenges you to clear approaching zombies with carefully placed clicks. Leave human survivors unharmed and use limited weapon items to handle larger groups. Successive zombie hits build combos, so keep identifying the next target correctly.

pages.title: Missiles Master
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Missiles Master puts your plane in hostile territory with missiles following its route. Steer away from their approach and try to make the missiles collide with each other, or keep evading them until their fuel is spent.

pages.title: 4 Two Dots
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: 4 Two Dots challenges you to link matching colored dots and reach each level's target. Connect two or more of the same color in a useful chain, choosing your links around the remaining arrangement on the board.

pages.title: Ratatouille: Sara's Cooking Class
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Ratatouille: Sara's Cooking Class takes you into Sara's kitchen to make a French vegetable dish. Follow her instructions and select the indicated kitchen items, working through the preparation steps until the ratatouille is ready.

pages.title: Brave Tomato 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Brave Tomato 2 turns vegetable battles into a physics-based aiming puzzle. Launch the tomato toward the evil vegetables and use the scene's wormholes to redirect the action, considering how each collision can move the remaining enemies.

pages.title: Barbie Spy Squad
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Barbie Spy Squad lets you prepare Barbie and her friends for their next mission with coordinated spy outfits. Browse the clothing choices and style each member of the squad, putting together a distinct look for the new job.

pages.title: Valentines Rooftop Dinner
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Valentines Rooftop Dinner lets you arrange a romantic evening for a couple. Decorate the rooftop setting to suit Valentine's Day, then choose an outfit for the girl so her finished look matches the atmosphere of the dinner.
